title: 第 N 个神奇数字
summary: 能被 a 或 b 整除的正整数是神奇数字，返回第 n 个神奇数字对 1e9+7 取模。
insight: 不超过 x 的神奇数字数量由容斥为 x/a+x/b-x/lcm(a,b)，随 x 单调；二分第一个计数至少 n 的 x。
pitfalls: 最小公倍数计算要用长整型
二分答案本身先不取模

solutions.title: 容斥计数二分答案
solutions.idea: 在数值域查找第 n 个并集倍数。
steps: 若 count(middle)>=n 则 high=middle，否则 low=middle+1；返回 low%MOD

code.java: class Solution { public int nthMagicalNumber(int n,int a,int b){long lcm=(long)a/gcd(a,b)*b,low=1,high=(long)n*Math.min(a,b);while(low<high){long middle=low+(high-low)/2,count=middle/a+middle/b-middle/lcm;if(count>=n)high=middle;else low=middle+1;}return(int)(low%1000000007);}private int gcd(int a,int b){while(b!=0){int temporary=a%b;a=b;b=temporary;}return a;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun nthMagicalNumber(n:Int,a:Int,b:Int):Int{val lcm=a.toLong()/gcd(a,b)*b;var low=1L;var high=n.toLong()*minOf(a,b);while(low<high){val middle=low+(high-low)/2;val count=middle/a+middle/b-middle/lcm;if(count>=n)high=middle else low=middle+1};return(low%1000000007).toInt()};private fun gcd(aInput:Int,bInput:Int):Int{var a=aInput;var b=bInput;while(b!=0){val temporary=a%b;a=b;b=temporary};return a} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int gcdValue(int a,int b){while(b){int temporary=a%b;a=b;b=temporary;}return a;}public:int nthMagicalNumber(int n,int a,int b){long long lcm=(long long)a/gcdValue(a,b)*b,low=1,high=(long long)n*min(a,b);while(low<high){long long middle=low+(high-low)/2,count=middle/a+middle/b-middle/lcm;if(count>=n)high=middle;else low=middle+1;}return low%1000000007;} };
